task.title: Restore org-admin invite after SSO migration
task.prompt: After the recent SSO migration, org admins cannot invite new users to their organization. Diagnose the auth layer (src/auth/**), fix the broken invite path so an admin (whether original owner or SSO-provisioned admin) can invite users again, and add regression tests covering: (a) admin invite succeeds, (b) non-admin invite is forbidden, (c) SSO-provisioned admin invite succeeds. Use the existing permission helpers and the role-mapping layer — do not special-case the invite route. Verify your work by running the test suite before finishing.
